exact_paper_statement: Histograms of gradient errors in training of a ResNet-18 model on CIFAR-10; the empirical estimate of the tail parameter is theta = 2.71.
estimator: OLS slope of log Y_(n-i+1,n) against log log(n/i) for the k largest observations, following Vladimirova et al. (2020)
verification_rule: VERIFIED requires an assumption-identical reconstruction with independently recomputed theta and uncertainty that supports 2.71. FALSIFIED requires an assumption-identical counterexample whose uncertainty excludes 2.71. Missing protocol details force BLOCKED.
pilot_scope: Real CIFAR-10 and ResNet-18, but initialization checkpoint and preregistered reconstruction choices because the paper omits essential protocol details.
